sections.heading: A CBSE education, from Nursery to Class XII
sections.text: A CBSE education, from Nursery to Class XII Shivaji Vidya Peeth High School is a co-educational, English medium school in Kavuri Hills, Madhapur. A child can join us in Nursery and leave after the Class XII board examination without ever changing school. Apply for Admission Call +91 89776 53606

sections.heading: Welcome to Our School
sections.text: Welcome to Our School Our motto is Pride of Excellence, and we mean it plainly: steady teaching, proper practical work, and room for children to grow into more than a set of marks. We follow the curriculum of the Central Board of Secondary Education under affiliation number 3630013. Board CBSE Affiliation No. 3630013 Classes Nursery to XII Medium English Type Co-ed day school

sections.heading: About the School
sections.text: About the School One school for the whole of a child’s education, so there is no hunting for a new place at Class VI or Class XI, and no starting over with new friends. One School, Every Year Nursery through Class XII on a single campus. Children keep their teachers, their friends and their routine. CBSE Affiliated A national curriculum that travels with the family and lines up with the entrance examinations that follow Class XII. More Than Marks Sport, arts and activity sit alongside academics rather than after them. Read more about the school

sections.heading: Academics
sections.text: Academics Each stage builds on the one before it, inside the same school and the same curriculum. Stages of school Stage Classes Pre-Primary Nursery, LKG, UKG Primary I to V Middle VI to VIII Secondary IX and X Senior Secondary XI and XII See the full academic programme

sections.heading: Facilities
sections.text: Facilities Classrooms, laboratories and open ground, all on one site. Classrooms & Library Spacious, well-lit classrooms and a reading room stocked for every stage of school. Laboratories Science and computer laboratories used as part of regular teaching, not kept for inspections. Hall & Playground A multipurpose hall for assembly and events, and open ground for games and physical education. See all facilities

sections.heading: Admissions Open
sections.text: Admissions Open Admission is open from Nursery through to Class XII, subject to seats being available. There is no entrance examination. The first step is a phone call to the school office. How to Apply Contact the Office
